description: Implementation class of CustomerAttributeDao, managing data access for CustomerAttribute entities using QueryDSL and JPA in a Spring-based application.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeDaoImpl
classes.description: Jpa repository implementation for CustomerAttribute entities, providing various query methods.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches CustomerAttribute by its ID, joining related entities for comprehensive fetch.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Fetches CustomerAttribute by MerchantStore, customer ID, and attribute ID.

methods.name: getByCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttribute objects associated with a specific customer within a store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Fetches CustomerAttribute objects that match a specific OptionValue ID within a store.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttribute objects filtered by Option ID within a store.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Provides the JPA EntityManager used for queries.
